Field Descriptions

wdogcmp0

Compare register. Value that gets compared to wdogs. KEY reg must be written to before any other register in this addrmap can be written to, unlocking the WDT. After writing to another register, the WDT will be locked again, and KEY must be written to again to unlock it.
